description: Create a single Supabase SQL file defining all RPC functions (SECURITY DEFINER, with internal admin/ownership checks) needed by the jobs + banners providers, then rewrite both provider Dart files so EVERY .from('jobs')/.from('job_applications')/.from('banners') read AND write is replaced by a matching .rpc() call. Also revert the temporary DEBUG passthrough in error_utils.dart. This is one coherent unit because the RPC names/params in Dart must exactly match the SQL definitions; they cannot be verified independently.
steps: STEP 1 - Create supabase/jobs_banners_rpc.sql. Header comment explaining it fixes the PGRST205 schema-cache issue by moving all jobs/job_applications/banners access behind SECURITY DEFINER RPCs. Every function: LANGUAGE sql or plpgsql, SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public, and a matching GRANT EXECUTE ... TO authenticated. Reuse existing public.is_admin() (do NOT redefine it). For ownership checks use auth.uid()::text compared to job_applications.user_id (cast user_id::text too, mirroring existing policies). End the file with: NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

STEP 2 - In jobs_banners_rpc.sql define these READ functions. get_active_jobs(p_category text default null, p_search text default null) RETURNS setof public.jobs: SELECT * FROM public.jobs WHERE status='active' AND (p_category IS NULL OR category = p_category) AND (p_search IS NULL OR title ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100. get_jobs() RETURNS setof public.jobs (admin-only: IF NOT is_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION; else SELECT * FROM public.jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200) - used by adminJobsProvider. get_job_by_id(p_job_id uuid) RETURNS setof public.jobs: SELECT * FROM public.jobs WHERE id = p_job_id AND (status='active' OR is_admin()) . get_job_applications(p_user_id text) RETURNS setof public.job_applications: IF auth.uid()::text <> p_user_id AND NOT is_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized'; END IF; SELECT * FROM public.job_applications WHERE user_id::text = p_user_id ORDER BY applied_at DESC. get_submitted_applications() RETURNS setof public.job_applications (admin-only): SELECT * WHERE status='submitted' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 200. get_job_applicant_count(p_job_id uuid) RETURNS integer (admin-only): count all applications for the job. get_job_slot_count(p_job_id uuid) RETURNS integer: count where status IN ('applied','submitted','approved'). has_applied_to_job(p_job_id uuid, p_user_id text) RETURNS boolean: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_applications WHERE job_id=p_job_id AND user_id::text=p_user_id). get_banners() RETURNS setof public.banners: SELECT * WHERE is_visible = true ORDER BY sort_order ASC (visible-only feed for home). get_all_banners() RETURNS setof public.banners (admin-only): SELECT * ORDER BY sort_order ASC.

STEP 3 - In jobs_banners_rpc.sql define these WRITE functions (plpgsql). apply_to_job(p_job_id uuid) RETURNS uuid: uses auth.uid() for user_id; INSERT INTO job_applications(job_id,user_id,status,applied_at) VALUES(p_job_id, auth.uid(), 'applied', now()) RETURNING id (the existing enforce_job_slots trigger still runs on INSERT). submit_job_task(p_application_id uuid, p_submission_type text, p_submission_url text, p_submission_note text) RETURNS void: verify the application belongs to auth.uid() (SELECT user_id ... ; IF user_id::text <> auth.uid()::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION); UPDATE job_applications SET status='submitted', submission_type=p_submission_type, submission_url=p_submission_url, submission_note=p_submission_note, submitted_at=now() WHERE id=p_application_id. create_job(p_data jsonb) RETURNS uuid (admin-only): INSERT selecting fields from p_data (title, description, category, payment_amount, max_slots, deadline, cover_image_url) with created_by=auth.uid(), status='active', created_at/updated_at=now() RETURNING id. Cast numeric/int/timestamptz fields from jsonb appropriately (e.g. (p_data->>'payment_amount')::numeric, (p_data->>'max_slots')::integer, (p_data->>'deadline')::timestamptz). update_job(p_job_id uuid, p_data jsonb) RETURNS void (admin-only): UPDATE only the keys present in p_data using COALESCE(p_data->>'key', existing) style or dynamic; simplest correct approach: UPDATE jobs SET title=COALESCE(p_data->>'title',title), description=COALESCE(p_data->>'description',description), category=COALESCE(p_data->>'category',category), payment_amount=COALESCE((p_data->>'payment_amount')::numeric,payment_amount), max_slots=CASE WHEN p_data ? 'max_slots' THEN (p_data->>'max_slots')::integer ELSE max_slots END, deadline=CASE WHEN p_data ? 'deadline' THEN (p_data->>'deadline')::timestamptz ELSE deadline END, cover_image_url=COALESCE(p_data->>'cover_image_url',cover_image_url), status=COALESCE(p_data->>'status',status), updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_job_id. delete_job(p_job_id uuid) RETURNS void (admin-only): DELETE FROM jobs WHERE id=p_job_id (cascades to applications). get_application_core(p_application_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(user_id text, job_id uuid) (admin-only, used by approve/reject to fetch the two ids): SELECT user_id::text, job_id FROM job_applications WHERE id=p_application_id. update_application_status(p_application_id uuid, p_status text, p_rejection_reason text default null) RETURNS void (admin-only): UPDATE job_applications SET status=p_status, rejection_reason=COALESCE(p_rejection_reason,rejection_reason), reviewed_at=now(), reviewed_by=auth.uid() WHERE id=p_application_id. create_banner(p_data jsonb) RETURNS uuid (admin-only): INSERT banners(title,image_url,link_type,link_campaign_id,link_page,is_visible,sort_order,created_by,created_at,updated_at) from p_data with created_by=auth.uid(); cast link_campaign_id via (p_data->>'link_campaign_id')::uuid when present, is_visible via (p_data->>'is_visible')::boolean, sort_order via (p_data->>'sort_order')::integer. update_banner(p_id uuid, p_data jsonb) RETURNS void (admin-only): COALESCE-style update of the same columns + updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_id. delete_banner(p_id uuid) RETURNS void (admin-only): DELETE FROM banners WHERE id=p_id. Add GRANT EXECUTE for EVERY function to authenticated.

STEP 4 - Rewrite lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart. Replace each .from() as follows, preserving provider names/return types/invalidations. availableJobsProvider: final response = await SupabaseService.client.rpc('get_active_jobs', params: {'p_category': category == 'All' ? null : category, 'p_search': search.isEmpty ? null : search}); return List<Map<String,dynamic>>.from(response as List). jobCategoriesProvider: call rpc('get_active_jobs') with both params null, iterate rows for 'category' (keep the dedupe/sort/'All' logic). jobSlotCountProvider: final c = await rpc('get_job_slot_count', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}); return {'filled': (c as int? ) ?? (c as num).toInt()} - handle int return; keep the {'filled': int} shape. jobDetailProvider: final response = await rpc('get_job_by_id', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}); final list = List<Map<String,dynamic>>.from(response as List); return list.isEmpty ? null : list.first. hasAppliedToJobProvider: final r = await rpc('has_applied_to_job', params:{'p_job_id': jobId, 'p_user_id': user.id}); return r == true. myJobApplicationsProvider: rows = List<Map>.from(await rpc('get_job_applications', params:{'p_user_id': user.id}) as List); apply the statusFilter client-side (rows.where((r)=>r['status']==statusFilter) when statusFilter!='all'); keep applied_at DESC ordering (RPC already orders); then enrich each row by calling rpc('get_job_by_id', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}) and taking .first (or {} if empty), keeping the {...row,'jobs': jobRow ?? {}} shape and the try/catch. adminJobsProvider: List<Map>.from(await rpc('get_jobs') as List). adminJobApplicantCountProvider: return int from rpc('get_job_applicant_count', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}). adminJobSubmissionsProvider: rows = List<Map>.from(await rpc('get_submitted_applications') as List); keep the per-row enrichment - users still fetched via .from('users') (LEAVE AS-IS), jobs fetched via rpc('get_job_by_id', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}) taking .first; keep {...row,'users':userRow ?? {}, 'jobs': jobRow ?? {}} shape.

STEP 5 - Rewrite the write methods in jobs_provider.dart JobsActionsNotifier. applyToJob: replace insert with await rpc('apply_to_job', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}); keep the currentUser null-check and all ref.invalidate calls. submitTask: await rpc('submit_job_task', params:{'p_application_id': applicationId, 'p_submission_type': submissionType, 'p_submission_url': submissionUrl, 'p_submission_note': submissionNote}). createJob: await rpc('create_job', params:{'p_data': data}) - pass the raw data map as p_data jsonb (do NOT add created_by/status/timestamps in Dart; the RPC sets them). updateJob: await rpc('update_job', params:{'p_job_id': jobId, 'p_data': data}). deleteJob: await rpc('delete_job', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}). approveJobSubmission: replace the .from('job_applications').select('user_id,job_id')...maybeSingle() with rpc('get_application_core', params:{'p_application_id': applicationId}) -> List<Map>.from(...); if empty treat as not found; read userId=row['user_id'] (String), jobId=row['job_id'] (String). Replace the .from('jobs').select('title, payment_amount') with rpc('get_job_by_id', params:{'p_job_id': jobId}) -> .first or {}. Replace the .from('job_applications').update({status:'approved',...}) with rpc('update_application_status', params:{'p_application_id': applicationId, 'p_status': 'approved'}). LEAVE the credit_wallet rpc call and the .from('notifications').insert EXACTLY as they are. rejectJobSubmission: same pattern - rpc('get_application_core') for ids, rpc('get_job_by_id') for title, rpc('update_application_status', params:{'p_application_id': applicationId, 'p_status': 'rejected', 'p_rejection_reason': rejectionReason}); LEAVE the notifications insert as-is.

STEP 6 - Rewrite lib/features/home/providers/banners_provider.dart. bannersProvider: keep try/catch returning []; final response = await rpc('get_banners'); return List<Map>.from(response as List). adminBannersProvider: List<Map>.from(await rpc('get_all_banners') as List). createBanner: await rpc('create_banner', params:{'p_data': data}) (do NOT add created_by/timestamps in Dart; RPC sets created_by=auth.uid()); keep invalidations. updateBanner: await rpc('update_banner', params:{'p_id': id, 'p_data': data}). deleteBanner: await rpc('delete_banner', params:{'p_id': id}).

STEP 7 - Revert the TEMP DEBUG block in lib/core/utils/error_utils.dart. Remove the entire 'TEMP DEBUG' if-block that returns 'DEBUG: ${error.toString()}' for jobs/banners/pgrst/schema cache/column/relation. Leave the rest of the function unchanged so the 'not found' branch returns 'The requested data was not found.' and there is no DEBUG passthrough.

STEP 8 - Self-verify statically (Flutter not installed). Run: grep -rn "\.from('jobs')\|\.from('job_applications')\|\.from('banners')" lib/ -> MUST be empty. Confirm every rpc(...) name+param in both Dart files matches a function+param defined in supabase/jobs_banners_rpc.sql. Confirm brace and paren balance in both Dart files (count of { == } and ( == )). Confirm .from('users'), .from('notifications'), and rpc('credit_wallet') are still present and untouched.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `.from('jobs')`, `.from('job_applications')`, `.from('banners')` across lib/ returns ZERO matches

supabase/jobs_banners_rpc.sql exists, defines every RPC referenced by the Dart code, each SECURITY DEFINER + SET search_path=public + GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated, reuses existing public.is_admin(), and ends with NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

Every .rpc('name', params: {...}) in both Dart files matches a function name AND parameter names in the SQL file (p_job_id, p_user_id, p_data, p_id, p_application_id, p_status, p_rejection_reason, p_category, p_search, p_submission_type, p_submission_url, p_submission_note)
Provider names, return types, {'filled': int} shape, and the 'jobs'/'users' enrichment sub-maps are preserved; all ref.invalidate(...) calls remain
credit_wallet rpc call, .from('notifications') inserts, .from('users') reads, and lib/services/supabase_service.dart are unchanged
error_utils.dart no longer contains the 'DEBUG:' passthrough and the not-found branch returns 'The requested data was not found.'
Brace and paren counts balance in both rewritten Dart files
verification: grep -n "rpc('" lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart lib/features/home/providers/banners_provider.dart  and cross-check each name/param against grep -n 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION' supabase/jobs_banners_rpc.sql

for f in lib/features/jobs/providers/jobs_provider.dart lib/features/home/providers/banners_provider.dart; do echo $f; echo braces; grep -o '{' $f | wc -l; grep -o '}' $f | wc -l; echo parens; grep -o '(' $f | wc -l; grep -o ')' $f | wc -l; done
findings: REVIEW-FIX (iteration 1, 2026-09-20-052902-review.md NEEDS_CHANGES) - addressed all 3 issues in supabase/jobs_banners_rpc.sql; no Dart call sites changed (all rpc names/params identical). Cross-checked the real edit-form maps: lib/features/admin/screens/post_job_screen.dart (jobs) sends category=null and cover_image_url=null when blank, and always sends non-empty title/description; lib/features/admin/screens/manage_banners_screen.dart (banners) sends title=null when blank, link_campaign_id=null unless link_type=='campaign', link_page=null unless link_type=='page', and always sends image_url/link_type/is_visible. Schema (supabase/jobs_migration.sql, banners_migration.sql): jobs.title/description/status NOT NULL, category/cover_image_url nullable; banners.image_url NOT NULL, title/link_type/link_campaign_id/link_page nullable. ISSUE 1 (COALESCE swallows explicit null on edit): update_job now uses present-key CASE form for category and cover_image_url (col = CASE WHEN p_data ? 'col' THEN p_data->>'col' ELSE col END) so a present-with-null key clears the column and an absent key leaves it; title/description/status stay COALESCE (NOT NULL, form always sends). update_banner now uses present-key CASE for title (nullable, form blanks it); image_url stays COALESCE (NOT NULL, never nulled); link_type stays COALESCE (CHECK-constrained, always sent). ISSUE 2 (has_applied_to_job oracle): converted from LANGUAGE sql to plpgsql and added guard `IF auth.uid()::text <> p_user_id AND NOT public.is_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized'; END IF;` before the EXISTS; return type stays boolean, params (p_job_id uuid, p_user_id text) unchanged, Dart caller passes own id so unaffected. ISSUE 3 (link_page vs link_campaign_id inconsistency): update_banner link_page now uses the same present-key CASE form as link_campaign_id, so switching link_type page->campaign clears the stale link_page. Paren counts show ( 195 vs ) 200 in jobs_provider.dart, a 5-paren imbalance that ALSO exists identically in the original HEAD version (252 vs 257) and is caused solely by ')' characters inside string literals/comments (e.g. emoji/currency strings, '→ approved' comment), NOT by code structure.
